game.q: each eid comes about eleven days earlier every year. why?
opts: the islamic calendar follows the moon

wrong.early: sweet thought. the real reason is the moon.
wrong.weather: cute, but no. it visits every season in turn.

game.right: YES. a lunar year is about eleven days shorter, so each eid travels through every season in about 33 years.
